A streaming mode for offline productions that guarantees all mips are streamed in when rendering the current frame by issuing IO requests and immediately waiting on them until complete [S2].

The claim states that there is a streaming mode for offline productions that guarantees all mips are streamed in when rendering the current frame by issuing IO requests and immediately waiting on them until complete. Source [S2] explicitly states: 'For certain use cases (offline productions)... To guarantee all the mips are streamed in when you render the current frame, the streamer supports blocking requests. With blocking requests, the IO requests for loading in a given frame are issues and immediately waited on until they are complete.' This matches the claim exactly.
